title: chamomilla suaveolens
intro: Chamomilla suaveolens, commonly known as Whorled Wormwood or Downy Chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Chamomilla suaveolens include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help with anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, essential oils, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-bacterial effects.
